acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Host Chana Joffe-Walt talks to teachers and principals about the unique challenges the pandemic has created in their daily working lives.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: When school closed and threw routines into disarray, one mom and daughter figured out a new way to make it work. The question is: can it keep working?
acts.title: Big Mother Is Watching

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: The pandemic moved lots of families around, and many children simply vanished from school, in person, and online. Chana followed one student who re-enrolled at school after an 18-month absence — is it possible to jump back onto the treadmill?
acts.title: The Case of The Vanishing Sixth Grader
